Our client in Namur, Belgium is looking for a Business Intelligence Specialist / BI Analyst Developer with strong experience in Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS and Power BI.
 

You will maintain and enhance existing Business Intelligence solutions while developing new reporting, data integration and analytics capabilities. Working within an established BI team, you will contribute to ETL development, data modelling, OLAP solutions, dashboards and decision-support systems, supporting business reporting and monitoring requirements.
 

Location and set-up: Namur, Belgium. Hybrid: 50% remote and 50% on-site. Contract (contractor). Fluent French and English required. European candidates are welcome to apply, but need to relocate to Namur. Applicants must have the right to work in Belgium, as a work permit is not provided.
 

Tasks and responsibilities
 
 

• Analyse business requirements and design, develop and maintain Business Intelligence solutions that meet functional and technical specifications. 

• Develop reporting solutions, interactive dashboards and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) using data from operational databases. 

• Design, develop and maintain ETL processes using SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), ensuring reliable data extraction, transformation and loading. 

• Develop and maintain OLAP and multidimensional data solutions using SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS). 

• Create and maintain reports and visualisations using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and Power BI. 

• Design and optimise data models, including Star Schema and Snowflake Schema, and contribute to data architecture and modelling standards. 

• Produce technical analyses, data models, documentation and user guides while supporting knowledge transfer, training and end-user assistance. 

• Collaborate with the BI team to improve existing solutions, data integration processes and application architecture.  

Requirements
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree. 

• 3+ years of professional experience in each of the following areas: BI data modelling (Star Schema and Snowflake Schema); ETL development (Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services, SSIS); OLAP (Microsoft SQL Server Analysis Services, SSAS); reporting and visualisation (SQL Server Reporting Services, SSRS, and Power BI); databases (SQL Server 2019 or later and multidimensional databases). 

• Strong knowledge of SQL Server database structures, data integration and reporting architectures. 

• Experience analysing functional and non-functional requirements and translating them into effective BI solutions. 

• Ability to interpret database schemas, develop technical documentation and support BI users. 

• Understanding of data modelling, semantic representation and data quality principles. 

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a BI team. 

• Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.  

Nice to have: experience with Microsoft Business Intelligence Suite 2019 or equivalent; familiarity with JIRA; knowledge of reporting and decision-support solutions within the public sector or agricultural policy domain.
 

Key technologies and skills: Business Intelligence, Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Server 2019, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS, Power BI, ETL, OLAP, Data Modelling, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Multidimensional Databases, Reporting, Data Warehousing.
